hints.title: Bounded Enclosure Area
hints.text: Although the grid has 10^6 x 10^6 cells, the number of blocked cells is at most 200. A set of B blocked cells can enclose at most B * (B - 1) // 2 free cells.

hints.title: Bidirectional Traversal Threshold
hints.text: If a breadth-first search from source visits more than 20,000 cells without becoming trapped, the source is definitely not trapped. The same check must hold starting from target.

hints.title: Meeting or Escape
hints.text: Perform BFS from source: succeed if target is reached or step count exceeds threshold. Perform BFS from target: succeed if source is reached or step count exceeds threshold. Return true only if both succeed.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Traversing the entire 10^6 x 10^6 grid times out and exhausts memory.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bounding search depth by the maximum area enclosed by B obstacles limits exploration to at most 20,000 cells.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that 200 blocks cannot enclose more than B*(B-1)/2 cells and use bounded BFS from both ends.
complexity.notes: B <= 200 implies at most 19,900 enclosed cells.
